other_failure_modes.name: Execution crash due to categorical fillna
other_failure_modes.description: When mapping a categorical column with a dictionary, pandas returns a categorical series. Attempting to use `fillna()` with a value that is not present in the new categories raises a TypeError, causing the script to crash.

summary: The solution implements a robust cross-validated ensemble of gradient boosting models and performs extensive domain-specific feature engineering. However, the script crashes due to a pandas Categorical type error when handling missing values. Additionally, there is a severe data leakage issue because group-level aggregations are calculated on the combined train and test sets before splitting.
